item: 12. Guangxi Gongcheng Low Wind Speed Test (Jieyuan) wind farm lat 24.949, lon 110.795
farm: Guangxi Gongcheng Low Wind Speed Test (Jieyuan) wind farm
why: Identified: Mingyang's (601615) subsidiary 恭城洁源 built the 广西桂林恭城茶江低风速试验风电场 (49.5 MW; Xiling town, started July 2017). Mingyang's 2020 report transfers RMB 369.8 m of its RMB 493 m budget to fixed assets in 2020 (94.44% complete, RMB 32.1 m left), the remaining RMB 39.6 m in 2021 (100%); the company's tax holiday runs from 1 Jan 2020 (first revenue year). So most of the capacity went into service in 2020, the rest probably by 2021; no connection date quoted. GEM's Chinese name says 二期 and a separate 50 MW 'phase 2' (pre-construction) and a 150 MW 'Xinhua' record share the name; the relationships are unclear.

note_zh: 依深圳能源年報，2025 年轉入固定資產（達到預定可使用狀態）
note_en: Per Shenzhen Energy’s annual reports, transferred to fixed assets (intended usable state) in 2025
why: Not written in round 21: the year rests only on the 2025 transfer to fixed assets (an accounting step that can follow connection), not on a dated grid connection; year 2024 or 2025. Year from the owner's accounts, not a news report: Shenzhen Energy's 2024 annual report still lists 深能高邮三垛镇30MW分布式风电项目 as construction in progress at 31 Dec 2024 (97.40% complete, no transfer), and its 2025 report transfers RMB 190.68 million of it to fixed assets during 2025 (99.98%); the same report's policy note says self-built assets are transferred when they reach their intended usable state. All 6 turbines were erected by Aug 2023 (Gaoyou Today). No grid-connection news found (Shenzhen Energy/SZ SASAC pages 503/reset). If the caller prefers news-based years only, downgrade to lead.
